## Experience

- Full-Stack Developer, Road Biker Establishment, Hail, Saudi Arabia (Apr 2026 - present): runs road-biker.com and ilm-roadbiker.com, two live Arabic e-commerce stores with about 7,000 products and over a million visits; rebuilt the OpenCart 3 / Journal 3 storefront on PHP 8.1 and MySQL; integrated Apple Pay, instalment payments, shipping and abandoned-cart flows; migrated the catalogue to a new server while the shop kept trading; develops and maintains the Road Biker Flutter app (5,000+ downloads); administers the Linux servers.
- Freelance Web Developer, remote (Oct 2025 - Apr 2026): built and runs wordmarkremover.com (Next.js, Node.js, FastAPI, self-hosted AI image models); delivered raskamon.com and thehealthclinicstockholm.com for clients; built CertifiedSkill.
- Full-Stack Developer (Intern), Centangle Interactive, Islamabad (Apr 2025 - Oct 2025): React, Next.js, Node.js, MongoDB and REST APIs in an Agile team.
- Web Developer, RobAiotics Corp., remote, United States (Jan 2025 - Apr 2025): React, Next.js and Node.js features and API integrations.
